archive_temporal_scope.missing_boundary_policy: Contemporary comparisons must not be fabricated; missing data must be explicitly reported as unobserved.

perspectives.name: The User
perspectives.focus: Expressed concerns, goals, emotional statements, instructions, decisions, and evolution over time.
perspectives.boundary: Distinguish explicit statements from inferred motives. Do not treat inferences as established facts.

perspectives.name: People Discussed
perspectives.focus: Documented or reported behavior of third parties.
perspectives.boundary: Strictly separate direct quoted messages from user descriptions. Prohibit clinical diagnosis and motive attribution.

perspectives.name: Relationships and Turn Dynamics
perspectives.focus: Recurring interaction sequences, boundaries, corrective feedback, conflicts, and repair attempts.
perspectives.boundary: Preserve contradictory evidence; do not treat user repetition as independent corroboration.

perspectives.name: ChatGPT Assistant
perspectives.focus: Model advice, assumptions, hallucinations, corrections, and conversational influence.
perspectives.boundary: Track when model-introduced interpretations are repeated downstream as if independently established premises.

comparison_periods.periodName: Period 1: Early Adoption and Exploratory Use
comparison_periods.focus: Initial platform onboarding, short-form queries, open-ended conceptual exploration, and foundational interpersonal discussions.
comparison_periods.dataLimitations: Covers initial four months of archive; uneven message density; variable model slug metadata.

comparison_periods.periodName: Period 2: Established Operational and Multi-Domain Work
comparison_periods.focus: Deep multi-turn engineering dialogues, technical system design, business operational drafting, iterative prompt refinement, and complex relationship reflection.
comparison_periods.dataLimitations: Absence of uploaded attachment binaries limits validation of referenced documents, images, and code files.

comparison_periods.periodName: Period 3: Mature Workflow Integration and Late Interaction
comparison_periods.focus: Procedural state machine design, structured prompt constraints, rigorous source checking, and complex multi-step technical execution.
comparison_periods.dataLimitations: Terminates abruptly at August 5, 2026 (timestamp 1783624140 / conversation-file-123 / shard 13-14); does not extend to the present day.

comparison_periods.focus: Unobservable contemporary usage period (mid-August 2026 to October 2026).
comparison_periods.dataLimitations: Completely absent from the archive export. No conversation or message records exist in this timeframe; contemporary comparisons cannot be synthesized or fabricated without new external export retrieval.

questions.question: Which substantive topics, unfinished projects, and technical investigations outside relationship material merit resumption, and what precise context is needed to continue them?
questions.subject: Substantive technical projects, workflows, operational designs, and creative investigations outside relationship material
questions.perspective: User goals, project lifecycles, and practical continuation
questions.method: Filter candidate clusters to exclude personal relationship discussions; traverse branch histories along individual conversation DAGs to extract initial problem statements, technical constraints, generated artifacts, stopping nodes, and unfulfilled next steps; formulate actionable resumption prompts.
questions.evidenceRequirements: Mandatory citation fields: source_file, source_record_index, conversation_id, mapping node_id, message_id, and message.create_time. Requires verification that stopping points are evidenced in source turn text, accompanied by cross-conversation contradiction checks to verify the project was not completed in a later thread.
questions.limitations: Export attachment byte payloads are absent, preventing inspection of uploaded schematics, images, or code attachments. Chat record cannot verify external execution states, repository commits, or offline progress.
questions.intendedOutput: Navigable Revisit Catalog schema (topic_id, project_title, technical_domain, initial_objectives, stopping_node_citation, context_summary, concrete_resumption_prompt).

questions.question: What were the user's specific operational directives, and how did assistant outputs iteratively adapt when challenged or corrected by the user?
questions.subject: User directives, negative feedback, corrective constraints, and assistant adaptive revisions
questions.perspective: User directives and Turn-by-Turn Interaction dynamics
questions.method: Identify branch-linear turn sequences containing corrective markers, boundary pushback, or negative constraint adjustments; compare pre-correction assistant output with post-correction assistant response across the exact parent-child exchange.
questions.evidenceRequirements: Mandatory paired citation quadruplets: user directive node ID, assistant initial draft node ID, user correction node ID, and assistant revised node ID. Distinguish explicit user dissatisfaction from general topical drift.
questions.limitations: Verbal agreement or revised textual compliance by the assistant does not establish real-world factual correctness, computational validity, or sustained user satisfaction beyond the immediate exchange.
questions.intendedOutput: Request-Correction Ledger (exchange_id, directive_type, user_correction_citation, initial_assistant_flaw, assistant_adaptation, resolution_status).

questions.question: Where did assistant-introduced assumptions, hallucinations, or unverified claims influence subsequent user prompts and conversational trajectory?
questions.subject: ChatGPT unsolicited framing, ungrounded claims, and downstream conversational influence
questions.method: Perform provenance tracing on factual claims, domain heuristics, and psychological/interpersonal interpretations introduced by the assistant; track downstream conversation turns to verify whether the user adopted, questioned, or uncritically amplified the assistant's assertion.
questions.evidenceRequirements: Chronological provenance chain citing first occurrence node ID in assistant output, subsequent user citation node IDs, and verification of whether the user had articulated the concept prior to the assistant's turn.
questions.limitations: The archive cannot adjudicate external empirical truth (e.g. engineering acoustics, statutory birth record laws, or official Scrum rules) without independent authoritative ground truth.
questions.intendedOutput: Assistant Influence and Assumption Queue (claim_id, introduction_node_citation, claim_text, unverified_elements, downstream_adoption_nodes, epistemic_risk_level).

questions.question: How did the user's ChatGPT interaction patterns, prompt complexity, role, and verification rigor evolve across chronological strata from August 2024 to August 2026?
questions.subject: User interaction patterns, procedural workflows, prompt engineering, and verification practices over time
questions.perspective: Chronological comparison across operational date strata
questions.method: Stratify conversations across three empirical date periods; sample comparable exchanges across seven dimensions (Purpose, User Role, Instructions, Interaction, Trust/Verification, Tools/Artifacts, Results); evaluate behavioral transitions while actively searching for continuities and counterexamples.
questions.evidenceRequirements: Exact timestamps from message.create_time placed within period boundaries; mandatory paired citations demonstrating claimed behavioral shifts alongside persistent baseline habits.
questions.limitations: Archive terminates on August 5, 2026; current October 2026 data is completely absent and cannot be compared. Behavioral shifts cannot be disentangled with certainty from underlying platform model upgrades (e.g. GPT-4 to GPT-4o).
questions.intendedOutput: Comparative Usage Evolution Matrix (period_id, dimension, observed_pattern, supporting_citations, counterexample_citations, continuity_notes).

questions.question: What interpersonal interactions and reported behaviors are documented, and how are third-party actions strictly separated from user reports, assistant interpretations, and clinical diagnostic labels?
questions.subject: Interpersonal dynamics, third-party reported behaviors, and relationship boundary negotiations
questions.perspective: Attributed Multi-Perspective Interaction (User vs. People Discussed vs. ChatGPT Interpretation)
questions.method: Extract interpersonal dialogue sequences and partition every assertion into four strict epistemic layers: (1) direct quotes/messages from third parties, (2) user retrospective event reports, (3) user subjective emotional assessments, and (4) assistant behavioral/diagnostic framing.
questions.evidenceRequirements: Four-way attribution metadata for all extracted claims. Strict tracking of diagnostic terms (e.g., borderline personality disorder / BPD): document exact speaker role, node ID, and provenance; prohibit treating diagnostic labels as validated medical facts.
questions.limitations: Absent third parties have no direct voice or representation in the export. Retrospective user reports are uncorroborated by external ground truth. It is methodologically impossible to determine clinical diagnoses or internal motives of discussed individuals from chat transcripts.
questions.intendedOutput: Attributed Interpersonal Interaction Register (incident_id, source_node_citations, direct_quotes, user_reported_events, user_affective_state, assistant_interpretive_framing, diagnostic_term_provenance).
